description: Lifecycle policy for model data in the canonical Spark layout.

minimax_h3.staging_note: H3 is a multimodal video/audio diffusion system. Do not invent PP layer shards until a component-aware runtime adapter exists.

quanttrio_glm52.staging_note: Retain only in verified cold storage until a production encoding is selected.

rules: A full model copy belongs in extnvme or verified cold storage, never in internal root storage.
A stage payload belongs in sparkdata/<model>.<weight-encoding>.<topology> and must have a manifest.
KV backing belongs in kvcache/<model>/<topology>.<format> and is never a symlink.
A rank-local checkpoint slice and common reference files belong in srcdata/<model>.<encoding>.<topology> and must have a manifest.
Models not listed here are report-only until explicitly classified.
Cleanup requires a per-node manifest with recorded size and file count; broad path deletion is forbidden.
